name: os_magic_pointer
notes: Dword 00000461h: file offset of the magic text

name: os_magic_text
notes: MPC2000XL

name: icu_init
notes: Interrupt controller set-up: edge, vectors 20h-27h, self-EOI, mask 06h

name: tick_handler_mask
notes: Tick handler masks its own input (bit 5 of C022)

name: panel_poll_byte
notes: Panel report receive and header dispatch

name: panel_wheel_ccw
notes: Header 80: DATA wheel counter-clockwise

name: panel_wheel_cw
notes: Header 81: DATA wheel clockwise

name: panel_key
notes: Headers 84/85: key press and release

name: panel_slider
notes: Header 86: NOTE VARIATION slider

name: panel_pad_strike
notes: Headers 90-9F: pad strike / release

name: panel_pad_pressure
notes: Headers A0-AF: pad pressure

name: midi_out_a_tx_handler
notes: Vector 27h: MIDI OUT A transmit

name: intc5_current_program
notes: INT C5h: returns ES:SI = the Program the pads play; changes AX and BP

name: led_refresh
notes: Writes all 13 LEDs from their flag bytes

name: led_bank_refresh
notes: Lights the current bank LED, clears the other three

name: delay_ms
notes: Waits until 0FE7:0B8A has advanced by CX; no timeout

name: int_e7_remap
notes: INT E7h: clears 0FE7:0067, rewrites PGR15-32

name: int_e8_restore
notes: INT E8h: restores PGR15-32 from the boot table, sets 0FE7:0067

name: midi_out_a_send
notes: Queue a message for MIDI OUT A: AH status, AL data 1, CL data 2; DS = 0FE7

name: midi_out_b_send
notes: Queue a message for MIDI OUT B; same interface

name: smpte_handler
notes: Vector 20h: optional SMPTE chip, ports 01C0-01C6

name: int8f_handler
notes: INT 8Fh inline-text service entry

name: all_loader
notes: .ALL loader

name: updater_short
notes: OS update: load, magic check, flash

name: updater_main
notes: OS update: main loader path with checksum

name: all_writer
notes: .ALL writer

name: main_screen_entry
notes: MAIN screen entry: clears 0FE7:0065 and installs MAIN key records

name: ver_version_text
notes: VER screen version text "1.2    "

name: pgm_dispatcher
notes: File dispatcher for first byte 07h (.PGM)

name: ax_dispatcher
notes: File dispatcher for first byte 0Ah (.APS and others)

name: os_checksum
notes: Word sum of file 0-77FFDh

name: boot_entry
notes: Boot block entry; physical FC400

name: boot_panel_id_wait
notes: Compares [006F] with E011h / E022h, up to 1,000 retries

name: boot_integrity_check
notes: INT 28h handler: magic then word sum; failure goes to the recovery loader

name: boot_int24_panel_rx
notes: Boot receive handler: C002 bit 1, read C000, bytes with bit 7 to [0070], others to [006F]

name: reset_vector
notes: JMP FAR FC00:0400; physical FFFF0 = file 7FFF0

name: app_data_segment
notes: Program and application data segment

name: key_ring
notes: Key event ring, write index at 0FE7:01B7

name: led_refresh_request
notes: Non-zero asks the main loop to refresh the LEDs (also 0064)

name: midi_a_running_status
notes: Running-status byte for OUT A

name: midi_b_running_status
notes: Running-status byte for OUT B

name: os_dgroup
notes: Global OS data segment (DS = ES = SS at cold entry, SP 0A7C)

name: pad_bank
notes: Current pad bank: 0, 10h, 20h, 30h for A-D

name: pad_velocity
notes: 16 bytes: velocity of each pad slot while held

name: panel_header
notes: Last panel report header

name: remap_open_flag
notes: Clear while INT E7h has PGR15-32 remapped

name: slider_value
notes: NOTE VARIATION slider, 0-7Fh

name: tick_ms
notes: Millisecond counter advanced by the tick
